module: State machine of a rally special stage's timer: elapsed time, activation, finish, frame time step and split times. Used by rallyManager (getStageTimingState). The module returns a constructor.
notes: Once complete, setActive no longer reactivates the timer; only reset puts it back to zero.
addTime ignores values <= 0 and returns false if the timer is not active.

reset.desc: Resets everything: status idle, inactive, not finished, time 0, no splits.

setActive.desc: Activates or pauses the timer (status 'active' / 'idle'). No effect if the timer is finished (it stays inactive).

active.desc: true to start/resume (only the strict value true counts)

advance.desc: Advances the timer by dt if it is active and not finished, storing the start and duration of the frame; otherwise frameDt is 0.

dt.desc: Time step in seconds (0 if nil)

addTime.desc: Adds seconds to the elapsed time (penalty, for example for a recovery).

returns.desc: true if the time was added

completeAt.desc: Ends the timer: status 'complete', freezes finishTime and elapsedTime.

time.desc: Finish time; current elapsed time if nil

recordSplit.desc: Records a split time for a path node, if splitData.isSplitTiming. Fills in splitData.time and splitData.source if absent.

source.desc: Origin of the time ('tracker' by default)

returns.desc: Recorded entry, nil if splitData is invalid

markSplitMissing.desc: Marks a split as missing (without time) with a reason; the entry replaces any existing entry.

getSplitTimes.desc: Table of splits keyed by pathnodeId.

getSplitOrder.desc: List of pathnodeIds in recording order.

isActive.desc: True if the timer is running (active and not finished).

isComplete.desc: True if the timer is finished.

getTime.desc: Finish time if it exists, otherwise elapsed time (seconds).

getFrameStartTime.desc: Time at the start of the last frame processed by advance.

getFrameDt.desc: Duration of the last frame processed by advance (0 if inactive).

getState.desc: Snapshot of the state: status, active, complete, elapsedTime, finishTime, frameStartTime, frameDt, splitTimes, splitOrder (the splits tables are shared, not copied).
